visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two identical twin young women with long black hair are seated at a table inside a dimly lit, upscale restaurant. They smile joyfully at the camera. In front of each woman is a white plate containing a small square chocolate cake with a lit candle on top. The woman on the left wears a brown and white striped strapless top, and the woman on the right wears a white and black strapless top. (2) The women perform a synchronized hand dance consisting of clapping their hands together, crossing their arms to tap their opposite shoulders, and then extending their hands forward with palms facing upward while wiggling their fingers. The background features dark wooden textures, large backlit oval mirrors, and warm glowing pendant lights. (3) They repeat the rhythmic hand movements in perfect unison while maintaining bright, cheerful expressions. The candles on the cakes flicker in the foreground as they continue their dance. In the far background, a wooden booth and other out-of-focus restaurant elements are visible under warm artificial lighting.
